# sendgrid_subscription_tracking_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide subscription tracking setting, which adds a subscribe/unsubscribe link to the bottom of emails. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one subscription tracking configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_subscription_tracking_settings" "this" {
  enabled       = true
  plain_content = "If you would like to unsubscribe, click here: <% %>"
  html_content  = "<p>If you would like to unsubscribe, <% click here %></p>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether subscription tracking is enabled.

### Optional

- `html_content` (String) The HTML for the unsubscribe link, appended to the bottom of HTML emails.
- `landing` (String) The HTML displayed on SendGrid's hosted landing page after a recipient clicks unsubscribe.
- `plain_content` (String) The plain-text unsubscribe content, appended to the bottom of plain-text emails. Must contain the `<% %>` tag, or recipients will have no URL to unsubscribe from.
- `replace` (String) A custom replacement tag to place unsubscribe content anywhere in an email template.
- `url` (String) The URL where unsubscribing recipients are sent, if not using SendGrid's hosted landing page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `subscription_tracking_settings`.
